title: Structure-Preserving Target-Size Compression

preservationSummary.structural: Searchable text, vector page content and interactive PDF objects remain structural PDF content; digital-signature validity is not guaranteed after rewriting.
preservationSummary.raster: Searchable text, vector content, forms, links, annotations and signature interactivity are not preserved.

acceptance: Users can enter a target in bytes, KB or MB and select a preservation preference.
Every target-size run starts with the existing structure-preserving optimizer before raster fallback is considered.
The target-size ladder is bounded to at most six attempts and proceeds from higher to lower raster fidelity.
A target is reported as met only when the output is both smaller than the source and at or below the requested target.
Strict preservation never rasterizes; an unattainable target produces either the smallest structure-preserving improvement or an explicit refusal.
Target-priority mode returns the first target-hitting raster result at the highest tested fidelity, otherwise the smallest real improvement as best effort.
Before/target/output byte evidence, attempt count and a preservation summary are shown for target-size results.
No persistent schema or executable-version cut occurs in P15.
